{
  "name": "turntype",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "A typing challenge while Claude works: press 1 in an empty prompt, or run /type.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Dan",
    "url": "https://github.com/Danovich"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/Danovich/turntype",
  "repository": "https://github.com/Danovich/turntype",
  "license": "GPL-3.0-or-later",
  "keywords": [
    "typing",
    "typing-test",
    "wpm",
    "game",
    "mod"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "adaptive": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Adaptive words",
      "description": "on: about a third of the words practice your weakest letter pairs. off: random words only.",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "on"
    },
    "dailyGoal": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Daily goal (minutes)",
      "description": "Minutes of typing a day, shown above the prompt beside your streak. off: the streak alone.",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "3",
        "5",
        "10",
        "15",
        "30"
      ],
      "default": "5"
    }
  }
}
